summary: Repaired the Node-wrapper probe and requested its first execution. Two harness faults are fixed: every snapshot of the wrapped node is now taken through its status channel (node.Status, executed inside the run loop) instead of reading raft fields from the test goroutine - the earlier readings were inadmissible and once reported an impossible pair (committed 3 with last index 0) - and the bare leader now broadcasts its appends after becomeLeader, which it does not do by itself, so the wrapped node finally observes leader 1 in term 1 and the premise of the comparison can be established. The verified native run then shows: control, while node 2 is a plain member it proposes successfully (0ms, no error, leader index advances to 2); premises, after the removal the leader's configuration no longer contains node 2 and after the re-add it does again while node 2 has caught up and still knows leader 1 in the same term 1; witness, Propose then returns only when its 300ms context deadline fires (context deadline exceeded) with the leader's log index unchanged at 4, so the proposal never reaches the group. The requested basis carries seven comparisons (two controls, three premises, two witness assertions with the unchanged-leader antecedent); the attempted leadership-change control is deliberately excluded because my campaign attempt did not win in the draft run, and that remains a limitation. Expected receipt outcomes: the controls and premises hold, and both witness comparisons are violated.
